extracted.intended_audience: inventors, patent agents/attorneys, patent examiners, and other IP stakeholders seeking USPTO training
extracted.subtask_description: A listing and brief descriptions of USPTO-offered patent trainings, workshops, webinars, and examiner training materials, including audience, format, CLE availability, and whether sessions are recorded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Application Assessment Pilot program
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshop that focuses on providing assistance in assessing the strengths and weaknesses of a potential patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience: Inventors. Course format: Virtual. CLE Available? No. Recorded? No.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stakeholder Application Readiness Training (START)
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshop that focuses on the fundamentals of the patent application process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience: Inventors. Course format: Virtual. CLE Available? No. Recorded? No.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stakeholder Training on Examination Practice and Procedure (STEPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Derived from newly hired examiner training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience: Agent/Attorney. Course format: course (Virtual or In-person). CLE Available? Yes. Recorded? No.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor course
rubrics_metrics.description: Course offering for inventors (listed separately under patent examination trainings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience: Inventors. Course format: Virtual or In-person. CLE Available? No. Recorded? No.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stakeholder Offerings and Resources (SOAR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Series that provides Intellectual Property training for all stakeholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience: Inventors and Agent/Attorney. Course format: Virtual. CLE Available? Yes. Recorded? No.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor Info Chats
rubrics_metrics.description: Webinar series on topics of interest to inventors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience: Open. Course format: Webinar. CLE Available? No. Recorded? Yes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Quality Chat
rubrics_metrics.description: Webinar series on patent quality topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience: Open. Course format: Webinar. CLE Available? No. Recorded? Yes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner Training Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Computer-based training (CBT) modules used to provide practice and procedure training for newly hired patent examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audience: Open (used for newly hired patent examiners). Course format: CBT. CLE Available? No. Recorded? Yes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience (training selection criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The target participants for each training (e.g., Inventors, Agent/Attorney, Open).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use audience to choose appropriate offerings: inventor-focused workshops and webinars vs. agent/attorney courses vs. materials for examiners and broad stakeholder offerings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course Format (training delivery dimension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Format in which the training is delivered (e.g., Virtual, In-person, Webinar, course, CBT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format affects accessibility and suitability: webinars and virtual workshops for broad outreach; in-person courses for deeper, interactive instruction; CBT for examiner onboarding and self-paced procedural training.

rubrics_metrics.name: CLE Availability (continuing legal education)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates whether a training provides continuing legal education credit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marked as '*CLE' on the page. Relevant primarily to attorneys/agents seeking CLE credits; CLE availability varies by offering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recorded? (archival/accessibility indicator)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates whether the training is recorded and therefore available for later viewing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recorded sessions increase accessibility for stakeholders who cannot attend live events; several webinar series and CBT modules are recorded/available.
